sections.heading: Alma vs Grow Therapy: Overview
sections.content: Alma and Grow Therapy represent two different approaches to helping therapists build insurance-based practices. Alma charges $95-125/month but provides comprehensive tools including AI-powered Note Assist, EHR, scheduling, and often negotiates $10-30 higher reimbursement rates per session. Grow Therapy is completely free, taking a percentage of reimbursements, and offers the fastest credentialing in the industry (5-7 days) with included practice management tools. Alma was acquired by Spring Health in January 2026.

sections.heading: Pricing & ROI Analysis
sections.content: Alma costs $95/month (annual) or $125/month (monthly) with no free tier. However, Alma often negotiates $10-30 higher per-session reimbursement rates than solo credentialing. At 20 sessions/week, even a $10 rate improvement generates $800/month in additional revenue - more than covering the membership. Grow Therapy is free with revenue sharing. The question is whether Alma's higher rates offset its membership cost for your volume.

sections.heading: Platform Features
sections.content: Both platforms include EHR, scheduling, and AI-assisted documentation - unusual for Grow Therapy given its free model. Alma adds community features like peer consultation groups, continuing education, and clinical advisors (Esther Perel, Lori Gottlieb). Grow Therapy includes integrated telehealth while Alma requires providers to use their own. Grow Therapy guarantees claims, providing payment security. Alma pays weekly; Grow pays weekly (7 business days after insurance).

sections.heading: Credentialing & Network
sections.content: Grow Therapy has a significant credentialing advantage: 5-7 days average vs industry standard of weeks to months. This makes Grow ideal for therapists wanting to start seeing insured clients quickly. Grow has 19,000+ providers in all 50 states. Alma's acquisition by Spring Health creates one of the largest mental health platforms. Both work with major payers (Aetna, Cigna, UHC). Alma uniquely works with Oscar and Oxford.

recommendations.when: You see 20+ sessions/week and can benefit from higher negotiated reimbursement rates that offset the $95-125/month membership
You're a new therapist wanting the fastest credentialing (5-7 days) and free access to practice management tools while building your caseload
You value community features like peer consultation, CE resources, and access to clinical advisors
You want a completely free platform with no upfront risk and prefer guaranteed claims
You need integrated telehealth rather than using a separate platform

faqs.q: Is Alma worth $125/month vs free Grow Therapy?
faqs.a: It depends on your volume. Alma often negotiates $10-30 higher per-session rates. At 20 sessions/week with a $10 rate improvement, you'd earn $800/month more - far exceeding the membership cost. For lower-volume practices, Grow Therapy's free model may be better.

faqs.q: Which has faster credentialing: Alma or Grow Therapy?
faqs.a: Grow Therapy has significantly faster credentialing at 5-7 days average - one of the fastest in the industry. Alma's credentialing timeline varies by payer and isn't as specifically advertised.

faqs.q: Do both Alma and Grow Therapy include AI notes?
faqs.a: Yes, both include AI-assisted documentation. Alma calls theirs 'Note Assist' and includes it in membership. Grow Therapy also includes AI documentation features in their free platform.

faqs.q: What happened to Alma with Spring Health?
faqs.a: Spring Health acquired Alma in January 2026, creating one of the largest mental health platforms in the US. Alma continues to operate under its own brand with expanded resources.
